description.en:
Stops or restarts the match AI for everyone. The value is stored as a mode byte. With any non-zero value, the match skips its AI update, so the computer-controlled players stop making decisions. 0 lets the AI run again. Every reader found only tests zero against non-zero, so 1 and 2 behave the same.
It also posts a matching on/off request to another part of the match (the same kind of request the event-mode switch uses); what that part does was not traced.
Match setup resets the mode to 0. The shipped scripts use 0 and 2, both in btl0002.nut.
0 = AI runs, any other value = AI stopped (the scripts use 2).

true once the mode is set.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
